corrected_value.title: Mitigation system threat partially mediates the effects of right-wing ideologies on climate change beliefs.

decisions.location: Introduction (lines 24-25); Study Two Results, Exploratory analyses on the dimensions of conservative ideology (line 122); Study Two Summary and conclusions (line 126); References 62 (line 243)
decisions.quote: Participants invested in tradition, following those in power, and supporting the persecution of deviants (i.e., the dimensions of right-wing authoritarianism) also tended to report lower pro-environmentalism. When pitted against each other, we replicate recent findings that of these dimensions, SDO-E and Traditionalism demonstrate strongest unique associations with environmentalism [62].
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state file exists for this work. In addition to retesting Baldwin and Lammers' (2016, Ref 9, DOI 10.1073/pnas.1610834113, represented by shipped row 2384) temporal framing interaction across Studies One and Two, Study Two conducts a dedicated set of multiple regression analyses (reported in Results at line 122 and S11 Table, irrespective of experimental framing condition) pitting the two subdimensions of social dominance orientation (SDO-D, SDO-E) and three subdimensions of right-wing authoritarianism (Authoritarianism, Conservatism, Traditionalism) against each other as predictors of each environmentalism outcome. Both the Study Two Results (line 122) and Study Two Summary and conclusions (line 126) explicitly compare these unique associations to Clarke et al. (2019, Ref 62) and state that the analysis replicates Clarke et al.'s finding that SDO-E and Traditionalism demonstrate the strongest unique negative associations with environmentalism while the remaining subdimensions are weak and inconsistent predictors. Per review instructions, explicit empirical retesting in Results and Discussion is a valid replication target even when conducted in exploratory analyses and discussed in the Introduction. Because Clarke et al. (2019) is a distinct original paper and finding absent from shipped row 2384, target_index 1 is a genuinely missing original target.
